_note: Single source for the OIDC redirect URI (flutter-login-and-app-shell task 3.3): Gradle reads this file for the Android deep-link manifestPlaceholder AND CI passes it via --dart-define-from-file, so the native registration cannot drift from the Dart configuration. An explicit --dart-define=OIDC_REDIRECT_URI wins over this file; the OIDC_REDIRECT_URI environment variable applies only when this file is absent. Dev default below; production uses its IdP-registered URI.
